reviews.text: We boarded our dog here a few times, everyone is so helpful and friendly! From scheduling to boarding our dog, everything is made very easy. The employees are fantastic with our dog and each time he when back he was happy to see certain people he previously interacted with. Clean facility too! Highly recommend!!

We use second home every time we travel and I have endless good things to say about them. Regular check ins and photos, little videos of my dog obsessed with the play pool, everyone is an absolute pleasure and so professional to communicate with. Just feels so reassuring to trust the place he’s staying at so I can actually enjoy my trip. 10/10 recommend 💕

Second Home Pet Resort is truly heaven on earth for pets! I HIGHLY recommend to anyone in need of care for there pets. I had to fly to Chicago for a wedding and couldn't bring my service dog because I wasn't sure how she would handle going on a plane ride. I have never left my dog alone for even one day or overnight. She hasn't even been home alone for more than an hour or two. Obviously leaving her anywhere with anyone for the very first time was a struggle and extremely nerve wrecking for me and my dog. Not with Second home pet resort… it was truly such a blessing knowing she was in safe hands! The staff were all so welcoming, kind and understanding.

I specifically want to thank and talk about MEGAN and JA! These two women are absolutely the sweetest and most loving animal people I've ever met!! Megan spent so much time answering all of my questions I had before making my pets reservation. After speaking with her, I felt so at peace and knew my dog was going to have a wonderful time. She helped me get my puppy signed up for pool play time and informed me of the 24/7 live video cam access which I added, so I could see my puppy at all times in her room. MEGAN also gave me an in person tour of the entire resort which was gorgeous! I was able to look at all the room options and then I decided to go with the indoor/outdoor patio elite suite. Words cannot express how thankful I am for MEGAN going above and beyond helping me! She is such a sweetheart and she is the main reason I decided to book my reservation for my puppy at this resort. Also, I would like to thank JA. She was in charge of taking care of my puppy during her pool time. I have to say, she is absolutely wonderful! JA went out of her way and sent me the most precious photos of my puppy having the time of her life! She even threw balls into the water for my dog because I told her that is her favorite. She looked so happy in every photo and I could tell she was having a blast! Thank you JA for taking such amazing care of my puppy!

Overall, I highly recommend Second Home Pet Resort! I consider myself to be quite the overprotective pet parent but with second home, I truly felt at ease throughout the entire process. From the moment I dropped my puppy off up until the day I went to pick her up I received incredible support and understanding from the staff. They made the whole process so relaxing and I had no worries leaving my baby girl. Thank you to everyone who took such excellent care of my puppy and being there to support me throughout the process as well. I will definitely be recommending Second Home Pet Resort to all my friends and family because this is without a doubt, the place to take your pet!

I’ve boarded my pup here twice now, and each time has been an amazing experience! The staff is incredibly kind and attentive, I could tell my dog was in great hands from the moment I dropped him off. One of the things I appreciate most is the 24/7 webcam access. Being able to check in on him whenever I wanted gave me so much peace of mind, especially while being away. It’s clear they truly care about the animals they look after. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for safe, trustworthy, and loving care for their dog!

First off this review is for the "new" owners.  I have been a customer for 10+ years now.  When I went and picked up my dogs today and was told that the daily rate was $160 a night for 2 dogs I thought they were joking.  I was even told that the total included an 8% surge pricing fee.  Well long story short you lost a 10 year customer.  I have been considering rover.com and now my mind is made up.  Good bye and good luck running a once very successful business into the ground because of your greed!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but after giving this facility a second chance, I deeply regret it.

The first incident resulted in my dog's anal glands rupturing, requiring approximately $1,800 in veterinary care. Since that incident, he has continued to have anal gland issues. The facility refunded my boarding stay at that time.

I trusted them again, only for my dog to come home with an eye injury requiring another veterinary visit, a corneal stain, medication, and another vet bill. My veterinarian advised that redness from this type of injury does not appear immediately, making it entirely possible the injury occurred while he was in their care.

After spending nearly $1,000 on this boarding stay and thousands of dollars with this business over the years, they refused to reimburse a $200 veterinary bill and denied any responsibility based solely on their own internal review.

I have completely lost confidence in their care. I will never trust them with my dog again, and I cannot recommend them to anyone looking for a safe place to board their pet.

We love Second Home Pet Resort. Our little Dora does daycare several times a week and we've also boarded her. Since attending daycare, she's become less shy around both people and other dogs. She also usually comes home ready to nap so we know she's playing/exercising which is great during summer when we can't take as many walks.

The staff is amazing and the facility is nice and clean, and has a water park for the doggies.

Can't recommend enough!

I had to leave my cat Dana for about 12 days (on platinum package) for Christmas traveling, and they were wonderful to her. My cat was so depressed the first few days we left since this is her first time boarding. The staff did a wonderful job at helping her feel more comfortable and by the end of it she was a huge cuddle bug with them. They sent nightly report cards with photos and videos and she seemed so chipper with them by the end of her stay. They also made sure she was taking her medicine on schedule and eating. They're such a nice bunch of people and I'm happy they took good care of my baby!!!
